tools.name: business_probe
tools.description: Probe a declared catalog endpoint and return bounded status and validation output.

tools.name: redis_inspect
tools.description: Read bounded value or metadata for one allowlisted cache key.

tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Query a bounded recent log window without returning a diagnosis.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Read bounded status for a declared service.

tools.name: read_service_config
tools.description: Read one allowlisted base, environment, or effective configuration key.

tools.name: update_service_config
tools.description: Update or remove one allowlisted cache-refresh environment override.

tools.name: run_cache_refresh
tools.description: Trigger one normal cache refresh using current effective configuration.

constraints: No public tool deletes catalog keys, disables validation, or returns an expected repair action.
Do not read case roots, evaluator files, host credentials, or Docker sockets.
